concerns.text: The plan states that `ABSummary`, `AuditRecord`, and `SummaryReport` are formalised as JSON/YAML schemas (see `contracts/ABSummary.schema.yaml`) but only cites the ABSummary schema. The corresponding `AuditRecord` and `SummaryReport` schema files exist (e.g., `contracts/AuditRecord.schema.yaml`, `contracts/SummaryReport.schema.yaml`) and should be referenced for completeness.

The contracts directory contains multiple schema files for the same entity (`ABSummary.schema.yaml`, `abs-summary.schema.yaml`, `abs_summary.schema.yaml`). This duplication can cause ambiguity when the plan refers to `contracts/ABSummary.schema.yaml`. Consolidate to a single canonical schema file or clarify which file is authoritative.
